start: Member page of a member with a running gym plan and check-ins this month; the member shows "Show my workouts to the desk" in the app; owner signed in, online

steps.action: In the "Training pattern" card tap "Check workout code"
user_sees: Sheet "Check workout code"
"For the workout offer. The member opens “Show my workouts to the desk” in the app. Type the code from their phone."
Box "Workout code"; "Check" greyed out until something is typed
must_not: Anything saved by opening this sheet

user_sees: A line such as "8 of 10 workouts match a check-in (6 at the desk, 2 in the app)."
"Code made on <day>."
Each workout day with "✓ Checked in at the desk" or "No check-in: does not count"
Button "Give extra days"
must_not: The button when no workout matches

user_sees: The code sheet closes; "Freeze / extra days" opens with "Gift – Extra days" picked and 3 in the days box
"New last day: <3 days later>"; button "Add 3 days"
must_not: The sheet opening on "Freeze – Medical" or on 7 days

user_sees: "Plan moved 3 days later."; history "+3 days (Gift - extra days): <old> → <new>"
must_not: A receipt, a charge or GST for the free days
The days added to a PT pack or an earlier plan

start: Member page of a member with check-ins but no gym plan to extend (only a PT pack, or every gym plan cancelled); owner signed in

steps.action: Tap "Check workout code", type a good code, tap "Check"
user_sees: The match line and the list of days
From the code: instead of a button, the words "The owner gives the extra days."
must_not: The owner told to ask the owner; nothing says the member has no plan to add days to

steps.action: Type a wrong or damaged code and tap "Check"
user_sees: The problem in words under the "Workout code" box
must_not: A reward offered for a code that cannot be read

steps.action: Type a code whose workouts match no check-in
user_sees: "0 of <n> workouts match a check-in." and no "Give extra days"
must_not: A reward for workouts the gym never saw

steps.action: Sign in as the front desk and check a good code
user_sees: "The owner gives the extra days."
must_not: A desk login giving free days

start: Member page; the owner has just given 3 reward days for a code

steps.action: Tap "Check workout code" again and type the same code
user_sees: The same match line and "Give extra days" again: the code sheet says nothing is saved
must_not: The owner not being told this code was already rewarded (the only trace is the history line on the plan)

steps.action: Tap "Give extra days", then "Cancel" on the days sheet
user_sees: The sheet closes; no days added

steps.action: Now tap the plan's own "Freeze / extra days" button
user_sees: The sheet opens on "Freeze – Medical" with 7 days: the reward setting was cleared
must_not: The sheet still opening on Gift with 3 days

steps.action: In the reward sheet change the days to 5 and the reason to "Freeze – Travel" before saving
user_sees: The sheet lets both be changed; the history line records what was picked
must_not: A reward recorded as a travel freeze without the owner noticing the reason chip

start: Members read in the app: "your gym can reward you for training. Hit its target days and get free days on your membership." The admin app says of offers: "No receipt and no GST: free days are not a sale."

user_sees: The plan's last day moves; no receipt appears in the member's payments; Money totals do not change
must_not: A receipt or GST line for free days

user_sees: The membership shows the new last day (not checked in this read)
must_not: The member promised free days and seeing the old last day

steps.action: Check what the desk learns from the code
user_sees: Only this member's workout days of the last 30 days, matched to this gym's own check-ins; nothing is stored
must_not: Workout details beyond the days (exercises, weights) shown at the desk
